The '''''Esseles''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transport]] in operation during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Sometime during the year [[3643 BBY]], the ''Esseles'' was en route to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while secretly carrying the Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]]. Imperial agents aboard the cruiser learned of the Ambassador's identity, and sent word to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]]. His ship, one of the largest [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in the entire [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Sith fleet]], [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] the ''Esseles'' during its journey. Claiming that the Ambassador was a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in an attempt to arrest her. When the troops aboard the ship fought back, the Sith under the leadership of the ruthless [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Ironfist]] seized the bridge and put the ship under a security lockdown. After cancelling the lockdown, the ships' troops managed to retake the bridge.

After the ship was secured, a group of Republic operatives who had been traveling aboard the Esseles at the time boarded Kilran's vessel in order to disable the tractor beams and allow the ship to escape. They were successful in this endeavor, and the Esseles continued to Coruscant without incident.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Esseles'' is part of a flashpoint of the same name in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. There are two possible ways to bypass the security lockdown. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] way uses a reactor reset which [[kills]] everyone on the engineering deck. The other, being the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|path of the light side]], is to shut down all the secondary power conduits which are scattered throughout the ship.
